newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks edge down in slower trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks edge down in slower trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks edged down across the board on Thursday, as trade slowed down ahead of the long weekend due to Friday's banking holiday.
* Of 14 active shares 10 fell, two rose and two were flat.
* Turnover fell to 5.3 from 7.4 million kuna, while volume rose to 15,804 from 11,171, shares mostly thanks to one issue.
* The most active Dubrovnik-based shipper Atlantska Plovidba sold 10,129 shares. It lost 10 kuna from July to close at 150.
* Top loser, food processor Podravka, lost 18 kuna or 6.9 percent to 262, selling 2,376 shares.
* Koncar electrical concern was bigger of the two gainers, adding 50 kuna to 1,250. Only five shares changed hands. -- Zagreb Newsroom, +385-1-4557075
